subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Should the Control UI progress strip wait for the broader sessions.activity gateway contract, or should maintainers accept a smaller UI-only status strip first?
rationale: The requested phases depend on public session activity, subagent waiting, final delivery, and reconnect semantics; automation cannot choose the durable API/UX boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Gate on gateway contract
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 as the backend contract first, then add the compact Control UI surface on top of it.

options.title: Ship narrow UI first
options.body: Accept a smaller Control UI-only strip from existing chat/tool stream signals, with explicit follow-up to replace heuristics once the gateway contract lands.

options.title: Fold into canonical API issue
options.body: Close or re-scope this issue only if maintainers decide the UI request should be tracked entirely by the broader gateway activity item.

recommendation.title: Gate on gateway contract
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 as the backend contract first, then add the compact Control UI surface on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the best available owner for the public gateway/session activity direction based on the canonical related issue and gateway/protocol history.
